welcome_lead: Stamp the world of Pedro Almodovar, Spain's most famous director.
meta_desc: A-Level Spanish adventure on Pedro Almodovar's films and themes.

concepts.def: Spanish director born 1949, central figure in post-Franco cinema.
Cultural movement after Franco's death (1975 onward) explored in Almodovar's early films.

concepts.term: Mujeres al borde de un ataque de nervios
concepts.def: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown (1988), Almodovar's breakthrough film.
Volver (2006), centred on women in La Mancha; starred Penelope Cruz.
Actress closely associated with Almodovar's early films.
Melodrama; genre Almodovar reinvented, blending emotion, humour, and colour.

walkthroughs.body_html: Almodovar's first films channelled the Movida's energy. International recognition came with Mujeres al borde de un ataque de nervios (1988). He won the Foreign Language Oscar for Todo sobre mi madre (1999).
Almodovar's films explore women, sexuality, family, and Spanish identity in saturated colours. Recurring stars include Carmen Maura, Penelope Cruz, and Antonio Banderas.
El/la director(a) = director. El guion = screenplay. El rodaje = shoot. El reparto = cast. La banda sonora = soundtrack.
